text:
Maya (Partnerships): Hi team — Helios approved a short case story and sent over visuals. Need quick wins for the cloud marketplace tile + the 1-pager. Can we review logo usage, hero crop, and the 1200x600 tile copy? Targeting listing next Tue. Drive folder: https://drive.company/helios-redwood-case

assets-bot: Files uploaded: helios_logo.zip, helios_case_draft_v2.docx, helios_screenshots_v3.zip

Sam (Design): Opening the previews now. quick note — Helios logo has a circular mark and stacked wordmark. Which do we want in the marketplace tile?

Maya (Partnerships): Probably circular mark on tile (keeps clear at small sizes). Wordmark can go on the case study PDF.

Zoe (Brand Ops): Need SVGs with 16px safe padding and PNG @1x + @2x. Also confirm we have Helios brand approval form signed. Olivia, can you confirm?

Olivia (Helios PM): Confirmed — we attached a signed brand permission PDF in the Drive (helios_brand_ok.pdf). Use hex #0B74FF for primary accent if possible.

Kai (Marketing): For the marketplace tile copy — short headline + 2-line blurb. Draft: "Helios Cloud + Redwood Inference: 3x inference cost savings for GenAI pipelines" Blurb: "Learn how Helios reduced per-token cost by routing cold traffic to Redwood Dedicated pools while keeping latency under 150ms." CTA: "Read the case study"

Sam (Design): That works. I'll mock a 1200x600 tile. Question about screenshot crop: Helios wants their UI shown full-width — any brand rules?

Olivia (Helios PM): Screenshots okay as-is, but blur any customer names and mask emails. Helios legal asked for anonymization.

James (Legal): Noted. I need to review the screenshots before publish. Also confirm that the case study doesn't imply any revenue numbers that aren't in the signed doc. If we quote "3x cost savings" we need the backup metric in the appendix.

Maya (Partnerships): James — we have the metric in the appendix spreadsheet (drive link). Can you give a greenlight by EOD Friday?

James (Legal): I'll review; if nothing sensitive, should be fine. Will comment in the doc with redlines.

Sam (Design): Uploading tile mock -> https://figma.com/file/helios-tile-mock. Export sizes I'm planning: 1200x600 (marketplace), 600x300 (preview), 300x150 (thumb) and PNG + WebP. Export snippet: 
```
# Figma export presets
1200x600 @1x png
2400x1200 @2x png
600x300 @1x webp
```

Zoe (Brand Ops): Also need an alternative mono white logo for dark backgrounds and 40px minimum clearspace. I'll prepare brand-ready files once Sam confirms placements.

Kai (Marketing): Quick ask — 140-character one-liner for marketplace metadata (search). Proposal: "Helios & Redwood cut GenAI inference costs while keeping sub-150ms latency — see the case study." Thoughts?

Sam (Design): Good. I'll produce two layout options: image-left + text-right, and full-bleed hero with overlaid headline.

Olivia (Helios PM): We prefer full-bleed hero. Also, please use Helios photon gradient in the hero overlay (link to guideline in Drive).

Maya (Partnerships): Timeline check — Design mocks Thu AM, Legal review Thu afternoon, final assets Fri, schedule listing Mon for Tue launch. Everyone OK?

James (Legal): OK for timeline. Will prioritize Thu afternoon.

Zoe (Brand Ops): OK. I'll sign off on files Fri AM after Sam uploads exports.

Kai (Marketing): I'll draft marketplace copy and the 1-pager hero text by Thu noon.

Sam (Design): Uploading first mock now -> https://figma.com/file/helios-tile-mock#version1

Maya (Partnerships): Thank you. Final asks before we close: Sam — include alt text for hero images; Kai — include exact CTA URL; James — leave any redline comments directly in the case doc.

Olivia (Helios PM): Alt text for hero: "Helios dashboard showing model throughput with Redwood routing overlay". CTA URL: https://helios.com/redwood-case

Sam (Design): Added alt text and exported SVGs to Drive (helios_exports/).

James (Legal): Left two minor redlines on phrasing in the intro. Nothing blocking.

Zoe (Brand Ops): Downloaded exports, tidy. One piece: please remove drop shadow from logo on dark variant (Helios requested flat).

Sam (Design): Done — removed shadow, re-exported.

Maya (Partnerships): Approvals? If everyone is good I will hit publish flow on Monday morning.

Zoe (Brand Ops): :thumbsup: approved from brand ops.

James (Legal): :thumbsup: legal ok for marketing assets (will attach docs).

Kai (Marketing): :thumbsup: I'll queue marketing copy and schedule the marketplace listing for Tue.

Olivia (Helios PM): :thumbsup: Helios approved final visuals. Thanks all.

Maya (Partnerships): Great work team — closing thread. We'll post final asset links in the partnership repo after publish.
